scope: static label-axis control-flow review prompted by actual CPU V1 conservative label-order block

source_flow.behavior: reload preserves metadata labels as self.labels and requires 18 unique labels; it does not require canonical main order
NPZ stores raw logits with the saved metadata label order
Validates unique same-set 18 labels and explicitly reorders columns using [labels.index(l) for l in LABELS]

required_audit_behavior: Accept an exact 18-label set with any raw order; retain raw order and metadata hash, derive a bijective named permutation into canonical order, and reject missing, duplicate or unexpected labels. Do not alter saved adapter/head arrays or metadata.
required_probe_behavior: Apply the same validation and named alignment only for diagnostic probability checks; retain original saved NPZ unchanged.
reason_previous_exact_raw_order_is_wrong: The scored source deliberately accepts noncanonical component label order and aligns by names downstream. Requiring raw main order rejects a supported input without detecting an algorithm error.
